DNS::last_act
Description
This iRules command sets the action to perform if no DNS service
handles this packet
Note
: This command requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled
as part of GTM or the DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
last_act
<
allow
|
drop
|
reject
|
hint
|
noerror
>
DNS::last_act <allow|drop|reject|hint|noerror>
Sets the action to perform if no DNS service handles this packet (aka
Unhandled Query Action)
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
DNS_RESPONSE
,
GLOBAL_GTM
